svg.title: Separate changed-prior reference run: seed 616 NUTS draws compared with exact Beta(24,16) and original Beta(16,8) densities. This is distinct from exercise 6.3’s seed 6063 reference run.
svg.desc: Separate changed-prior reference: NUTS probability draws with seed 616 compared with exact Beta(24,16) and original Beta(16,8) densities. Prior concentration shifts and narrows this posterior. Exercise 6.3 uses a distinct seed 6063 reference.
